fact: The driver failed to follow the Race Director's Competition Notes by not staying to the right of the bollard in Turn 5.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Competition Notes (item 26.2, document 28).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 77 slowed down before Turn 5 to make way for an incoming car. When approaching the corner, he accelerated to make way for another incoming car, left the track while being to the right of the yellow line, but re-joined the track without staying to the right of the bollard in the runoff area. The Stewards acknowledge the efforts of the driver to manage traffic, but determine that it would have been possible to follow the instructions given in the Race Director's Competition Notes.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 77 Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions Escape Roads
